name: Dima
source:
Occupation: Owner of Strexa
Likes: Spanish guitar, health food
Dislikes: Being alone, discussing his past

A natural born leader, Dima sits at the top of Strexa's hierarchy as overseer of missions, tasks, training, and communications with politicians. He is trained expertly in field agent work, but has since resigned that aspect of his business to head their operations. He is kind, compassionate, and thorough. His kindness may be his biggest weakness.
